metadata.question: Did the water extent in Sebkha el Melah (29.135547, -1.187011) increase between August 12, 2024, and September 29, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Location: Sebkha el Melah at coordinates (29.135547, -1.187011) - this is a salt lake in Algeria/Tunisia region - Date range: August 12, 2024 to September 29, 2024 - Collection: Sentinel-2 (10m resolution, good for water detection) or Landsat 8/9 - Need to compare water extent in two time periods or directly compare the two dates 2. **Masking strategy**: - Use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) to detect water - NDWI = (NIR - SWIR) / (NIR + SWIR) or (GREEN - NIR) / (GREEN + NIR) - Mask clouds and shadows - Water typically has NDWI > 0.3 3. **Logic**: - Calculate water area (pixel count with NDWI > threshold) for early date (around Aug 12) - Calculate water area for late date (around Sep 29) - Compare: if Sep area > Aug area → Yes (A), if Sep area <= Aug area → No (B) - Handle C1 if no images found, C2 if no valid pixels after masking, C3 if calculation fails ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define location const lat = 29.135547; const lon = -1.187011; const point = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]); const buffer = point.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer for analysis // Define time periods const earlyStart = '2024-08-01'; const earlyEnd = '2024-08-20'; const lateStart = '2024-09-20'; const lateEnd = '2024-10-10'; // Function to calculate water extent function calculateWaterExtent(startDate, endDate, label) { const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const size = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${label} Images found: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { return null; } // Composite - use median to reduce noise const composite = col.median(); // Calculate NDWI for water detection // NDWI = (GREEN - NIR) / (GREEN + NIR) const ndwi = composite.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); // Water mask (NDWI > 0.3) const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0.3); // Count water pixels const waterPixels = waterMask.reduceRegion( { reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: buffer, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 } ).get('NDWI').getInfo(); // Total valid pixels const totalPixels = composite.select('B8').reduceRegion( { reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 } ).get('B8').getInfo(); console.log(`${label} - Water pixels: ${waterPixels}, Total: ${totalPixels}`); return waterPixels; } // Calculate for both periods const earlyWater = calculateWaterExtent(earlyStart, earlyEnd, 'Early (Aug 12)'); const lateWater = calculateWaterExtent(lateStart, lateEnd, 'Late (Sep 29)'); // Validation if (earlyWater === null || lateWater === null) { console.log('No data available for one or both periods'); console.log('C1'); return; } if (earlyWater === 0 && lateWater === 0) { console.log('No valid water pixels detected in both periods'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (earlyWater === null || lateWater === null || isNaN(earlyWater) || isNaN(lateWater)) { console.log('Calculation failure'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare water extent console.log(`Water extent comparison: Early=${earlyWater}, Late=${lateWater}`); console.log(`Change: ${lateWater - earlyWater} pixels`); if (lateWater > earlyWater) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
